_comment: Packages release.yml never publishes, with the reason. Everything else under python/, python/frameworks/ and typescript/packages/ is published when its version is not on its registry.

skip.traceai: the PyPI name traceai belongs to another publisher; the package has no registry name yet
skip.futureagi-hermes-plugin: Hermes plugin dependency manifest, explicitly not a buildable distribution

_pypi_bootstrap_comment: PyPI allows only three pending trusted publishers per organization, so these projects are created by their first upload with the PYPI_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN secret instead, and keep uploading with it: an upload that switches to trusted publishing before the project has a trusted publisher is rejected (403). To move a project to trusted publishing: add it to the futureagi organization, add its trusted publisher (release.yml, blank environment), then remove it from this list. Once the list is empty, delete the token on PyPI and the secret.
